title: Quantum-Inspired Tensor Network Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection: A MERA-Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2604.06541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate whether a multiscale tensor-network architecture provides a useful inductive bias for reconstruction-based anomaly detection in collider jets. Jets are produced by a branching cascade, so their internal structure is naturally organised across angular and momentum scales. This motivates an autoencoder that compresses information hierarchically and can reorganise short-range correlations before coarse-graining. Guided by this picture, we formulate a Multiscale Entanglement Renormalization Ansatz (MERA)-inspired autoencoder acting on ordered jet constituents. To our knowledge, a MERA-inspired autoencoder has not previously been proposed, and this architecture has not been explored in collider anomaly detection. We compare this architecture to a dense autoencoder, the corresponding tree-tensor-network limit, and classical baselines within a background-only reconstruction framework. translated_title: 量子启发的张量网络自编码器用于异常检测：一种基于MERA的方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究多尺度张量网络架构是否能为对撞机喷注的基于重构的异常检测提供一种有用的归纳偏置。喷注由级联分支过程产生，因此其内部结构天然地在角尺度与动量尺度上组织。这启发我们构建一种能够分层压缩信息、并可在粗粒化之前重组短程关联的自编码器。受此图像引导，我们提出了一种受多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）启发的自编码器，作用于有序排列的喷注组分。据我们所知，此前尚未有人提出过受MERA启发的自编码器，且该架构尚未在对撞机异常检测领域被探索过。我们在仅背景重构的框架内，将该架构与稠密自编码器、相应的树张量网络极限以及经典基线方法进行了比较。本文围绕两个主要……
tldr: 该论文首次提出了受量子多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）启发的张量网络自编码器，并将其应用于对撞机喷注的无监督异常检测任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first MERA-inspired tensor network autoencoder and applies it to unsupervised anomaly detection in collider jets.
